operations.title: Five-site affine closure requires the full Kummer occurrence module
operations.body: Entry 1329: scalar-base first-order primitives fail through degree 5, but after expanding V_i over all 32 labelled Kummer characters, degrees 0 and 1 fail while degree 2 closes at both tested fibers. Closure is scalar-free: d_z Omega=d_u Xi_Kum^(2). Since the physical period varies, the Gauss–Manin information is now typed as the projective boundary image of the entire affine solution module, not as an absolute class or selected primitive. Next object is R_infty: Sol_Kum^(2)->B_infty. Event ev-000000001346-8e01d33d-84fa-4268-85fa-ffffb2167400.
